description: Cloudflare custom WAF rules for MoneyCash — apply via dashboard or Terraform. Rule order: skip API challenges first, then block probes.

rules.description: Skip bot JS challenges on /api/* so browser fetch (send-otp, etc.) is not blocked
Block obvious path / query exploit probes
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "../") or (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union select") or (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "<script") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env")

rules.description: Edge rate limit for OTP send (tune thresholds in dashboard)
rules.notes: Prefer a Rate limiting rule (20/10m per IP) instead of managed_challenge for this path once API skip is active.
